description: Build complete dashboard data visualization: 6 stats cards (Total CHUs, Functional, Semi-Functional, Non-Functional, Community Health Promoters, Households Covered), donut chart showing CHU functionality distribution using Recharts PieChart, horizontal bar chart of top 6 counties using Recharts BarChart, stacked county functionality bars, and interactive county comparison table with search, CSV export, pagination. All derived from live tickets data with graceful fallback.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-003.json to understand requirements

Replace stats cards section (lines ~242-330): Create 6 cards in 2 rows of 3. Row 1: Total CHUs (FileText icon, count filteredTickets.length), Functional CHUs (CheckCircle icon, count tickets where status is 'open' or 'pending'), Semi-Functional CHUs (AlertCircle icon, count tickets where status is 'in-progress'). Row 2: Non-Functional CHUs (AlertCircle icon red, count by status), Community Health Promoters (Users icon, use 17499 from existing), Households Covered (Building2 icon, use 11.9M from existing). All cards: green-100 icon background, green-600 icon color, white card background, trend indicators with ArrowUp/ArrowDown

Build donut chart section using Recharts: Import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts'. Create data array with 4 segments: Functional (count, green-500), Semi-Functional (count, yellow-500), Non-Functional (count, red-500), Closed (count, gray-400). Render PieChart with center text showing total. Add legend below showing each status with count and percentage

Build horizontal bar chart section: Import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts'. Calculate top 6 counties by ticket count using tickets.reduce to group by county, sort descending, slice(0,6). Render horizontal BarChart with county names on Y-axis, bar fill green-500

Build stacked horizontal bars section: Create CountyFunctionalityBars component (inline). For each county, calculate functional/semi/non/closed percentages from tickets. Show top 8-10 counties by functionality rate. Each county: horizontal stacked bar with 4 colored segments (green, yellow, red, gray). Legend at bottom

Build county comparison table: Create table with columns: County (string), Total CHUs (number), Functional Rate (green progress bar %), Workforce (number), Households Covered (number). Implement search with useState + debounced filter. Add Export CSV button that generates CSV download using: const csv = data.map(row => Object.values(row).join(',')).join('\n'); const blob = new Blob([csv], {type: 'text/csv'}); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = 'county-comparison.csv'; a.click(). Add pagination: 8 rows per page, show 'Showing X-Y of 47 counties' text and page buttons

Implement data calculation with useMemo: Derive CHU metrics from tickets array. For counties with no ticket data, generate demo fallback: use kenyaCountiesData to calculate reasonable estimates. Ensure calculations handle empty tickets array gracefully
acceptance_criteria: 6 stats cards display with correct data from filtered tickets: Total, Functional, Semi-Functional, Non-Functional, Health Promoters, Households
Donut chart renders using Recharts showing 4 segments with legend, center total, and percentage breakdowns
Horizontal bar chart shows top 6 counties by ticket count with proper county names and bar values
Stacked bars section shows top 8-10 counties with functionality breakdown in 4-color stacked bars
County comparison table renders all 47 counties with search functionality that filters as user types
Export CSV button generates and downloads proper CSV file with all table data
Pagination works: shows 8 rows per page, page buttons change displayed data, shows correct 'Showing X-Y of Z' text
All calculations use live tickets data; gracefully handle empty data with sensible demo values
verification: npm run build:check passes with no TypeScript errors
Start dev server, login, scroll through entire dashboard
Verify 6 stats cards show numbers derived from tickets data (will show 0 or fallback if no tickets)
Verify donut chart renders with 4 colored segments and legend - click legend items to toggle segments
Verify bar chart shows top 6 counties horizontally with green bars
Verify stacked bars section displays multiple counties with 4-color percentage bars
In county table: type in search box - table filters in real-time, click Export CSV - file downloads with correct data
Click pagination buttons - table shows different rows, 'Showing X-Y' text updates correctly
Test with filtered data: select a county in filter card, verify all charts and table update to show only that county's data
